captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: production local name/content/document searches, routed search keys, previews, image player and actual silent AVI playback; print command preparation recorded by an isolated sink
limitations: No Android/MTP write or transfer, physical keyboard/mouse, external PDF application, native print-dialog interaction or physical print. D3D video pixels are not captured by RenderTargetBitmap; video playback is checked through real player state/position. Print sink verifies preparation only.
